articles.text:
WEST BENGAL Governor C V Ananda Bose has submitted to Union Home Minister Amit Shah his report on the communal vioflagging the state police's "fail-ures" and proposing a commission of inquiry into the incident. In the report, the Governor also said that radicalisation and militancy pose a serious challenge for West Bengal, especially

in Murshidabad and Malda districts, which share borders with Bangladesh. The violence in Murshidabad, which took place in the wake of the new Wagdf law, claimed three lives on April 11. While a man was killedin police firing, another man and his son died in mob violence.
